image_description: A black frying pan containing cooked food (appears to be a stir-fry or sautéed dish with herbs) sits on a black portable electric burner. The setup is placed directly on a bed of colorful, raw mixed vegetables (peppers, beans, onions) which serve as the background/surface. The image has a slightly grainy, low-resolution aesthetic.

The rectangular base of the burner seems to warp slightly where it meets the vegetables, lacking a sharp, rigid shadow or contact line.
The texture of the cooked food is somewhat muddy and lacks distinct ingredient definition, appearing slightly 'painted' rather than photographic.

To check for edge bleeding between the pan/burner and the chaotic vegetable background.
To verify the physical plausibility of the burner sitting on top of loose vegetables.
